augustine.name: Augustine of Hippo
augustine.bio: Bishop of Hippo and Doctor of the Church; the most influential Latin Father.

chrysostom.name: John Chrysostom
chrysostom.bio: Archbishop of Constantinople and Doctor of the Church, famed for his preaching ("golden mouth").

athanasius.name: Athanasius of Alexandria
athanasius.bio: Bishop of Alexandria and Doctor of the Church; defender of the divinity of Christ at and after Nicaea.

cyril-jerusalem.name: Cyril of Jerusalem
cyril-jerusalem.bio: Bishop of Jerusalem and Doctor of the Church; author of catechetical lectures.

irenaeus.name: Irenaeus of Lyons
irenaeus.bio: Bishop of Lyons, martyr and Doctor of the Church; defender of apostolic tradition against Gnosticism.

jerome.name: Jerome
jerome.bio: Translator of the Latin Vulgate and Doctor of the Church.

ambrose.name: Ambrose of Milan
ambrose.bio: Bishop of Milan and Doctor of the Church; teacher of Augustine.

origen.name: Origen
origen.bio: Alexandrian biblical scholar; hugely influential on interpretation, though some of his teachings were later condemned. Read with care.

gregory-the-great.name: Gregory the Great
gregory-the-great.bio: Pope and Doctor of the Church.

hilary-of-poitiers.name: Hilary of Poitiers
hilary-of-poitiers.bio: Bishop of Poitiers and Doctor of the Church.

basil-the-great.name: Basil the Great
basil-the-great.bio: Bishop of Caesarea and Doctor of the Church.

cyril-of-alexandria.name: Cyril of Alexandria
cyril-of-alexandria.bio: Bishop of Alexandria and Doctor of the Church.

the-venerable-bede.name: The Venerable Bede
the-venerable-bede.bio: English monk, historian and Doctor of the Church.

rabanus-maurus.name: Rabanus Maurus
rabanus-maurus.bio: Benedictine abbot and Archbishop of Mainz; biblical commentator.

theophylact.name: Theophylact of Ohrid
theophylact.bio: Byzantine archbishop and commentator on the Gospels.

thomas-aquinas.name: Thomas Aquinas
thomas-aquinas.bio: Dominican friar, theologian and Doctor of the Church; compiler of the Catena Aurea.

catherine-siena.name: Catherine of Siena
catherine-siena.bio: Dominican tertiary, mystic and Doctor of the Church.

teresa-avila.name: Teresa of Ávila
teresa-avila.bio: Carmelite reformer, mystic and Doctor of the Church.

brother-lawrence.name: Brother Lawrence of the Resurrection
brother-lawrence.bio: Carmelite lay brother in Paris; not canonized.
